name: Aeon Timeline
description: Aeon Timeline is timeline and project-planning software for organizing events, narratives, people, places, relationships, dependencies, research, and other structured project details across Mac, Windows, and iOS.
agentUseSummary: Aeon Timeline cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because timeline content is stored in user-controlled files and its published integrations are desktop-app syncing and manual import/export rather than an authorized third-party API.

blocked.label: Connect Aeon Timeline
blocked.description: Relay does not accept Aeon Timeline account, license, device, file, writing-app, or storage credentials without an authorized third-party API contract.

blocked.label: Access timeline files
blocked.description: Aeon Timeline files, CSV and TSV imports, exported documents and images, templates, and files in user-selected cloud storage are local artifacts rather than provider account authority.

blocked.label: Automate Aeon Timeline
blocked.description: Relay does not automate the desktop or mobile apps, private license services, browser UI, undocumented file internals, or Aeon Timeline's in-app Scrivener and Ulysses syncing.

blocked.label: Change or export timelines
blocked.description: Creating, reading, editing, syncing, importing, exporting, sharing, or deleting timeline content remains unavailable until Aeon Timeline authorizes a stable distributable integration contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Aeon Timeline authorizes and documents a stable third-party API or Relay ships a separately permitted local-file connector.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not mount unauthorized Aeon Timeline automation or silently give OpenClaw access to private timeline, writing-project, export, or storage files.
Relay does not mount unauthorized Aeon Timeline automation or silently give Hermes access to private timeline, writing-project, export, or storage files.

providerSetup.blocker: Aeon Timeline stores timeline content in files on the user's device or chosen storage service and publishes in-app Scrivener and Ulysses syncing plus user-driven file import and export, but no authorized third-party developer API. Its EULA also prohibits reverse engineering, decompilation, and disassembly, so Relay cannot infer an integration contract from local files, application behavior, or private services.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request account, license, device, writing-app, file, or storage credentials; inspect undocumented file internals; automate Aeon Timeline software or private services; or show Connect. Reconsider only after Aeon Timeline supplies written integration authorization and a current distributable API contract, or after Relay ships a separately authorized local-file workflow that complies with Aeon Timeline's terms.

evidence.supports: Aeon Timeline states that timeline content is saved in files on the user's device or chosen storage service, is not captured online, and can be edited without persistent internet access.
Aeon Timeline's published integrations are in-app bidirectional syncing with Scrivener and Ulysses plus user-driven CSV import and export.
Aeon Timeline documents local export to CSV or TSV, images, PDF, Markdown, and Word, read-only file sharing, and external cloud storage rather than a provider-hosted content API.
Aeon Timeline licenses the installed software to a single user and prohibits reverse engineering, decompilation, and disassembly.
